book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.title: The Very First Guh
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.0: Long, long ago there was nothing at all. Just a soft pink nothing, as soft as a pillow. And right in the middle of that nothing lay one crumb. A cheese nibble crumb.
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.1: The crumb lay there for a very long time. It got warm, it got round and it got... chonky. One day it opened two big blue eyes and said the very first word ever: 'Guh.'
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.2: And that's how the first guh was born. His name was Firstguh. Firstguh was all alone, so he did what every guh does when he feels lonely: he ate a cheese nibble. And another. And another.
book.guhs.bieb.eerste_guh.3: From every cheese nibble Firstguh shared with the pink nothing, a new guh grew. That's why guhs still say: share your snacks, gain your pals. Guh!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.eerste_guh.0: Where did the very first guh come from?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.eerste_guh.1: What was the very first guh called?
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.title: How Mother Chonky Got So Chonky
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.0: Mother Chonky used to be a perfectly ordinary guh. A little round, sure. But not THAT round. Not shrine-round. How did that happen?
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.1: It began on a rainy Tuesday. Mother Chonky baked a guh cake for every little guh in the Guhmension. That's a LOT of guhs. And of course she had to taste every cake first.
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.2: One bite per cake. But there were a thousand cakes. After cake five hundred she no longer fit through the door. After cake one thousand she no longer fit in the village. CHONK!
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.3: So the guhs built a shrine around her, so she wouldn't have to walk anymore. She's been sitting there ever since, sweet and enormous, looking after all the little guhs. Especially Guhbert.
book.guhs.bieb.moeder_vadsig.4: Her tummy is so big that a whole guhbelly fits inside, with a Dentist Guh and an Enzyme Guh. Help her out and you get a belly whistle. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0: Why did Mother Chonky get so chonky?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0.0: She tasted a thousand guh cakes
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.0.2: She slept for a hundred years
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.moeder_vadsig.1: What do you get for helping Mother Chonky?
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.title: The Secret of the Cheese Nibble
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.0: Why are cheese nibbles so yummy? Learned guhs have researched it for a hundred years. And while doing so, they ate a whole lot of cheese nibbles. For science, of course.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.1: Their conclusion: a cheese nibble is a little bit of cheese, a little bit of nibble and a whole lot of love. Give a guh a nibble, and you give it a little piece of love.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.2: That's why you become friends with a guh when you feed it nibbles. And that's why a fried cheese nibble (with Mika's Grease!) heals a guh all the way in one go. Extra love. Extra grease.
book.guhs.bieb.kaasknabbels.3: Nine cheese nibbles together make a block. And a frame of cheese nibble blocks makes a gate to the Guhmension. Nobody knows why. It sure smells lovely in there, though.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.0: According to the learned guhs, what's in a cheese nibble?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.0.0: Cheese, nibble and a whole lot of love
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.kaasknabbels.1: How many cheese nibbles go into one block?
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.title: Travel Guide to the Guhmension
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.0: Welcome to the Guhmension, the pink land of the guhs! Grab your compass and your nibbles: we're going on a trip. Tip: bring a Guhmension Super Compass, then you'll never get lost.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.1: The Guh Fields and the Guh Meadows: soft, pink and full of guhs. The Cheese Flats: yellow and a little bit stinky. The Pink Puffs: so soft you'll want to sleep in them.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.2: The Guh Peaks: cold and high, where the Enderguhs fly. The Chonk Cliffs: steep, so mind your tummy. The Guh Sea: blue and full of little guhfish. Underground: sparkly guh crystals.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmensie.3: And then there's Mika's Biome. Dark, scary and full of Mikas. Only go there with a good sword and an empty belly. Or a full one. Mikas don't care either way. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guhmensie.1: Which biome is dark and scary?
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.title: The Great Mika War
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.0: Not everyone in the Guhmension is sweet. There are also Mikas: dark, grumpy creatures who say NYEG in a very cross way. They steal nibbles and snatch little guhs.
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.1: Long ago, the Mikas challenged the guhs to a war. But guhs don't like fighting. They're far too chonky for that. So they suggested: rock-paper-scissors!
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.2: The Mikas kept winning. Because the Mika Boss cheated: he knew the secret CHONK gesture, which beats everything. Until one clever guh copied the gesture and threw it right back.
book.guhs.bieb.mika_oorlog.3: 'I'VE BEEN CHONKED!' cried the Mika Boss, and the war was over. Since then the Mikas live in their own camp. Sometimes they still grab a little guh. Then you know what to do. CHONK!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.mika_oorlog.0: How was the Great Mika War decided?
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.title: The Crown of the King Guh
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.0: In a castle far, far away lives the King Guh. Purple fur, a white mane, a very distinguished little mustache. He sits on a golden throne and rules over all the guhs. Sort of.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.1: His crown is called the Wahoog Guh King Crown. It's made of the very first gold of the Guhmension, found by the Golden Guh himself, and polished by a thousand little guh teeth.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.2: Whoever wears the crown must promise three things: cuddle all guhs, never take the last nibble and have a nap every afternoon. The King usually manages two.
book.guhs.bieb.koningskroon.3: The gatekeepers only let true guh friends in. How do you prove it? By sitting very chonkily, or by saying the secret guh word. It starts with an N...
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.koningskroon.0: What must you promise when you wear the crown?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.koningskroon.1: What letter does the secret guh word start with?
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.title: WAHOOG! The Guh Dictionary
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.0:
GUH: hello, bye, yes, yummy, and pretty much everything.

NYEG: I'm happy! (Or very cross, if a Mika says it.) So pay close attention to who's saying it.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.1:
CHONK: nice and lazy and round. A guh who chonks lies on the couch with a nibble.

CHONKY: plump, round, cuddly. The nicest compliment you can give a guh.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.2: WAHOOG: the happiest word of all. You shout it when you do something awesome: a fair ride, finding a Golden Guh, or eating a whole bag of nibbles in one go.
book.guhs.bieb.vahoeg.3: WAHOOG CHONK: the strongest metal in the Guhmension. Very happy and very chonky at the same time. Tools made of it never break. Just like a guh's love. Aww.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.vahoeg.1: What do you shout when you do something awesome?
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.title: Why the Moon Is Pink
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.0: If you look up at night in the Guhmension, you'll see a pink moon and pink stars. But once upon a time the moon there was just white. Boring white. So how did that happen?
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.1: A little guh named Guhmmie couldn't sleep. The moon was far too bright. So she climbed the highest Guh Peak and blew an enormous pink bubblegum bubble. It got stuck to the moon.
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.2: Ever since, the moon has been pink and shines softly, like a night-light. The stars? Those are the crumbs of the nibbles Guhmmie ate afterwards. She never came back down...
book.guhs.bieb.roze_maan.3: ...just kidding. She slept wonderfully afterwards. Try watching the sky in the Guhmension for a whole night. Maybe you'll see a tiny pink dot waving at you.
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.roze_maan.0: Why is the moon in the Guhmension pink?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.roze_maan.0.0: A bubblegum bubble is stuck to it
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.title: The Golden Guh and the Guhramid
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.0: Of all the guhs, there's one that shines like the sun: the Golden Guh. If you see him, you get to make a wish. Most guhs wish for nibbles. Very predictable.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.1: The Golden Guh loves hiding. Deep inside the pink Guhramid he has a secret chamber, where he lies chonking among the treasures. Sometimes he lets a treasure hunter in.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.2: Sometimes he plays Hide-and-Guh with Hidey Guh, but then he always wins: you can't see him anywhere, and yet he's shining. Nobody understands how he does it.
book.guhs.bieb.gouden_guh.3: Ever find him? Then very carefully bring him to the Dentist Guh, who knows exactly what to do with that much shiny chonkiness. Open wide!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.gouden_guh.0: Where does the Golden Guh hide?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.gouden_guh.1: Who do you bring the Golden Guh to?
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.title: A Journey Through the Guhbelly
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.0: Did you know you can live inside a guh? Well, inside a guhbelly. Mother Chonky gives you a belly whistle, and toot: you're standing in a soft pink room with a tongue for a rug.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.1: In every belly lives an Enzyme Guh. It only listens to the boss of the belly. Blub. It keeps everything tidy and digests whatever doesn't belong. Unwanted guests too.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.2: Want a bigger belly? Go to the Dentist Guh. For cheese nibbles, Wahoog Chonk Ingots and crystals, the Dentist Guh stretches your belly. Stretch, stretch... CHONK! Until it really can't go any further.
book.guhs.bieb.guhmaag.3: A belly is the snuggest home there is. There's always food nearby. And remember: the chonkier, the better. For the belly, that is. Your own tummy just stays your own tummy.
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.title: From Sled Hut to Fairground
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.0: Guhs are much too chonky to walk. That's why they invented the sled. It all started with the Sled Guh, high up on the Guh Peaks, in a little hut that smells of hot chocolate.
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.1: His sled was broken, until a kind stranger found a sled runner, a little guh bell and a pink ribbon. Then the Sled Guh taught everyone how to build rails. Ding-a-ling!
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.2: Soon the guhs built a whole fair, with a roller coaster full of chonk drops and guh corkscrews. Every ride: a Fair Ticket. The Fair Guh sells top hats for them. Fancy!
book.guhs.bieb.slee_kermis.3: And whoever finds Hidey Guh's house can play Hide-and-Guh: little guhs hiding in big rooms. The guhs' motto: play first, then chonk, then play some more. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.0: What did the Sled Guh need for his sled?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.0.0: A runner, a little bell and a ribbon
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.slee_kermis.1: What do you get for a ride on the roller coaster?
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.title: The Secret Guh Book
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.0: If you're reading this, you've found the secret bookcase. Well done, clever little sleuth! This is the most secret book in the whole library. Don't tell anyone. Except guhs.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.1: The big secret: Mikas used to be guhs too. They kept all their cheese nibbles to themselves and never shared. Their fur turned dark, their eyes turned red, and their 'guh' turned into 'NYEG'.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.2: But deep down inside, every Mika is still a little bit guh. That's why the oldest guhs say: if a Mika ever shares a nibble, maybe it'll turn pink again. It has never happened. Not yet.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.3: The second secret: the Guhmension only exists because someone once gave a guh a cheese nibble. Every nibble you share makes the pink land a little bit bigger. Truly.
book.guhs.bieb.geheim.4: So: share your nibbles, cuddle your guhs and take a nap now and then. Then everything will be fine. Signed, the Librarian. (Psst: secretly I read a comic now and then too.) WAHOOG!
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.title: The Guh End
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.0: Long ago, all the guhs shared their cheese nibbles. Then came Overlord Mika. He was the biggest, the meanest and the hungriest Mika of them all.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.1: Overlord Mika came up with a plan: if he had all the nibbles, the guhs would turn gray and skinny and the Mikas would be in charge. He called it 'the Great Nibble Heist'. Nyeg.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.2: He dug cheese cellars under the Guhmension to hide nibbles in, and stole the last big Enderguh. It never got a single nibble. Poor thing.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.3: On his Enderguh he flew to a faraway island: the Guh End. There he locked the nibbles inside crystals on tall cheese pillars, so nobody could reach them.
book.guhs.bieb.guheinde.4: But the guhs say a hero with twelve Eyes of Chonky will find the way. Smash the crystals, feed the Enderguh... and the nibbles come home. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guheinde.0: What did Overlord Mika put in the crystals?
gui.guhs.bieb.kwis.guheinde.1: What should you give the worn-out Enderguh?
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.title: The Diary of the Pantry Mika
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.0: Diary of Mika Nibblesworth, Head Keeper of the Silent Pantry. Down here under the holey cheese we keep ALL the cheese nibbles of the Guhmension. Nyeg, the guhs will never find them!
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.1: Pantry Rule 1: NO NIBBLING. Nibbling makes noise. The nibble sensors hear everything: footsteps, chopping and especially chewing. So always sneak, like a real Mika.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.2: Our guard is the Chonk Warden. He once ate so many stolen nibbles that he fell asleep, deep in the cheese. Now he's blind from all that sleeping, but his ears... they can hear a crumb drop a mile away.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.3: Three shrieks from the nibble shriekers, and he wakes up. That's our secret, nyeg! Any guh reading this had better run away fast. Or be very, very quiet. Guhs are never quiet. Hee hee hee.
book.guhs.bieb.voorraadkelder.4: PS: I secretly ate a nibble. Ever so quietly. The Chonk Warden heard me anyway... Whoever finds this: bring the nibbles back to the guhs, so they can finally be WAHOOG again. Nyeg... sorry.

gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.makkelijk: A whole minute to dress your model, and a sweet jury: every judge gives one extra point. Nice and relaxed, chonk!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.medium: The Chonk Pageant as always: 45 seconds to dress up, a fair jury.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.lastig: Only 30 seconds to dress up! And a strict jury: Miss Chonksley takes off two points for every piece of clothing that doesn't fit the theme, Mr. Glitterguh wants a matching set and Granny Nibbles is picky. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.makkelijk: The Mikas pop up more calmly and stay up longer. Fewer guhs in between (don't whack them!) and more golden Mikas.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.medium: Whack-a-Mika as always: faster and faster, more and more heads.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.lastig: Super fast Mikas that are gone in a flash, lots more guhs in between (don't whack them, nyeg!) and golden Mikas are rare.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.makkelijk: 10 strokes per hole and no penalty strokes: if your ball lands in the cheese sauce or goes off the course, it simply goes back. You tee off from the green mats, close to the hole.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.medium: Guh Golf as always: 8 strokes per hole, cheese sauce or off the course is a penalty stroke.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.golf.lastig: Only 6 strokes per hole plus penalty strokes, from the red tee mats all the way at the back. The Golf Guh puts out extra pink slime bumpers and her guh windmill spins twice as fast. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.makkelijk: The food falls more slowly and there's much less Mika's Grease. Munching without stress!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.medium: The Chonky Food Fest as always.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.smul.lastig: The food falls much faster and the Mikas throw down buckets of Mika's Grease. Only for true munch champions!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.makkelijk: A bite? You have plenty of time to reel it in (2 to 3.5 seconds). No fish gets away!
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.medium: The Guhfish Contest as always: on a bite, 1 to 2 seconds to reel it in.
gui.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.lastig: On a bite you only have half a second! And fish can wriggle off your hook: the heavier the fish, the bigger the chance. (The Mika Catfish always stays on, nyeg!)

gui.guhs.doolhof.rules: The Mikas stole cheese nibbles and hid them in my maze! Pick a level: I'll grow a brand-new maze. Find all the nibbles, then run to the exit in the north. Hedge Mikas snatch a nibble back if they tag you (ouch? nope, they just giggle). The real nibbles float sparkling above the hedges: you can see them from far away, but you'll have to find the way there yourself. The faster, the more wahoog!

gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.rules: Ladies and guhtlemen! Six games around my tent: pick one, or do the Great Hexathlon. Friends can join in (up to four at once, each in their own lane): whoever opens the game waits a moment for them. Every event gives 0 to 1000 hexathlon points.
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.nu.tooltip: No more waiting for friends: let's go!
gui.guhs.knabbelspelen.tabel.uitleg:
This is how the hexathlon points work (0 - 1000 per event):
- Nibble Bobbing: 30 points = 1000 (a golden nibble counts 3).
- Sack Race: finish in 7 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Mika Can Toss: 120 points = 1000 (10 per can, 20 extra for knocking them all down).
- Egg-and-Spoon Race: finish in 11 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Nail Plopping: three bottles in 20 seconds or faster = 1000; twice as long = 500.
- Pin the Tail on the Guh: your pin score itself (1000 right on the spot, 0 from 2.5 blocks away).
Didn't make it = 0. The Great Hexathlon: everything added up, 6000 at most!
